spans.s:
नञ् नञ्, ind. (in grammar) the technical
term for the negative particle न, q. v., negation.
—नञ्-अर्थ-निर्णय, अस्, m. ‘inquiry into the
meaning of the negative particle,’ N. of a chapter of
the grammatical work Vaiyākarṇa-bhūṣaṇa-sāra by
Koṇḍa-bhaṭṭa.
—नञ्-वाद-टिप्पणी, f. ‘commentary
[]
to the chapter of negation,’ N. of a grammatical work
by Raghu-deva.
